channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Top-ranked Knights stifle No. 4 Harrells Christian for Salter’s 700th win
item.description: Top-ranked Greenfield locked down No. 4 Harrells Christian 64-47 as Kobe Edwards led a balanced attack, giving coach Salter his 700th win and underscoring the Knights’ status as NCISAA 2-A team to beat.

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Jan. 31, 2026
item.description: NCHSAA Basketball Glance: Updated boys and girls standings, recent scores and Tuesday’s matchups across Big East, Eastern Plains, ECAC and Three Rivers conferences.

item.title: Mayor rebukes councilman over confrontation with resident
item.description: Wilson Mayor Carlton Stevens sent an email to Wilson City Council members reminding them the scope of their authority after a recorded confrontation between newly-elected Councilman Lenwood Ward and a Wilson resident escalated into a police call.

item.title: Ice storm reshuffles NCHSAA swimming postseason
item.description: Ice storm wiped out NCHSAA swimming regionals, sending area standouts straight to next week’s state meets at Triangle Aquatic Center based on entry times and seeds.

item.title: Bulldogs squander 13-point lead in 81-76 loss to Ferrum
item.description: Barton blew a 13-point second-half lead in an 81-76 home loss to Ferrum, as Gerren Jones scored 33 and Rodrigo Farias 22 to complete a season sweep despite Trey Fields’ 23-point double-double.

item.title: Sleight’s hot start powers Barton women past Ferrum 65-48
item.description: Layne Sleight’s 19 points and a smothering defense sparked Barton College to a 65-48 win and season sweep of Ferrum, as the Bulldogs forced 25 turnovers in the Conference Carolinas matchup.

item.title: Voter registration for 2026 primary ends Friday
item.description: Wilson County voters must register by Friday, Feb. 6, to vote in the March 3 primary with early voting Feb. 12-28.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of Jan. 19-23
item.description: Deed transfers recorded in the Wilson County Register of Deeds for Jan. 19-23 list numerous property sales, topped by a $427,500 transaction on Ardsley Road in Wilson.

item.title: ‘It came down quick’: Wilson gets its share of snow
item.description: After doubts about the forecast, Wilson woke up to about 8 inches of quick snowfall, bringing sledding and igloo-building, slick roads and freezing temperatures.

item.title: New library books: Danielle Steel's 'The Color of Hope' added to collection
item.description: The Wilson County Public Library adds new adult fiction, nonfiction, young adult, Spanish, and children’s titles, from Danielle Steel and Lee Child to Dav Pilkey and Jenny Colgan.
